articles.summary: Wheels Up Experience Inc. (NYSE: UP) today announced it has signed a definitive agreement with Embraer (NYSE: EMBJ) to purchase six factory-new Phenom 300E premium jets for delivery in the second half of 2027. The agreement builds on a longstanding relationship between Wheels Up and Embraer and follows nearly three years of discussions regarding the acquisition of new aircraft. The direct purchase from Embraer is expected to further expand Wheels Up's fully modernized fleet and support the company's growth in anticipated customer demand. The Phenom 300 series premium light jet, a core platform within Wheels Up's modernized jet fleet, has been the world's best-selling light jet for more than a decade, offering industry-leading operational performance, reliability, range and cabin comfort. articles.summary: Wheels Up Experience Inc. (NYSE:UP) today announced financial results for the third quarter of 2026. Highlights of the quarter, including GAAP results, non-GAAP financial measures and key operating metrics, are on pages three and four and incorporated herein. Commentary from Wheels Up's Chief Executive Officer George Mattson about the Company's financial and operating results for the third quarter of 2026 is included in an Investor Letter that can be found on Wheels Up's Investor Relations website at https://investors.wheelsup.com .
